description: This file defines the Firefox class extending BrowserType, implementing methods for connecting, environment setup, graceful shutdown, argument construction, and readiness detection for Firefox browser automation within the Playwright project.

classes.name: Firefox
classes.description: Represents the Firefox browser type, providing methods to connect, configure environment, handle shutdown, and monitor readiness within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: connectToTransport
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the Firefox browser via transport.

methods.name: doRewriteStartupLog
methods.description: Rewrites startup logs to handle specific error messages related to Firefox startup issues.

methods.name: amendEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment variables for launching Firefox, ensuring correct home directory and removing conflicting variables on Linux.

methods.name: attemptToGracefullyCloseBrowser
methods.description: Sends a message to close the Firefox browser gracefully.

methods.name: defaultArgs
methods.description: Constructs default command-line arguments for launching Firefox based on options.

methods.name: waitForReadyState
methods.description: Waits for the browser to be ready by listening for a specific log message indicating Juggler is listening.
